Home/Training

Eight waysto train.

Everything at SOHO Fit is built around one idea: a dedicated trainer and a program written for you. Pick where and how. We’ll handle the rest.

Book your free consultation →
  1. 01 In-Studio Training One on one, in a private studio built for it. Private 1-on-1 and partner sessions at Hyde Park or Westshore. →
  2. 02 At-Home Training Your trainer comes to you. At your home or community gym, anywhere in the Tampa area. →
  3. 03 Corporate Wellness Fitness, yoga and massage for your team. Group fitness, yoga and chair massage at your office. →
  4. 04 Nutrition Coaching Habits that support the work. One-on-one with a NASM Certified Nutrition Coach. →
  5. 05 Body Composition Go beyond the scale. InBody 270 scans, included with every training program. →
  6. 06 Assisted Stretch Mobility, recovery, range of motion. One-on-one guided stretching, 30 to 60 minutes. →
  7. 07 Kids & Teens Strength and confidence, early. Age-appropriate and sport-specific training, typically 7+. →
  8. 08 Prenatal & Postnatal Safe. Supportive. On your terms. Prenatal, postnatal and pelvic floor training. →
Partner training

Train with a friend, spouse or family member.

SOHO Fit specializes in private, one-on-one training, and also offers Partner Training. Your trainer structures and modifies each session for both of you, so you train together without losing personal coaching.
